header: Diddy Kong Racing's regular plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, 2-3 minutes with every timeout counted:
the launcher, Load ROM 6 s after it is up (the page starts RT64 only once it has the ROM, so the launcher builds no
shaders and says nothing to wait for), the logos to the title (shader_survey.js's titleReached(), a need), then the
menus to a new Adventure as a player picks it (Enter, then A until the game is in Timber's Island, a need that the
game is playing there), the hub driven about 20 s with the gas held, steering a while each way (roam()), and Dino
Domain's race (map 5) reached the way the game's own teleport to Future Fun Land loads a map (go(), since a player
gets to it only by winning the races before; a need that the map loaded with its racers) and driven 40 s toward each
checkpoint. web/play_plan_extended.json goes on to two more races, for when a longer play is needed.
